invariant: All damage and secondary state applications emitted by one synchronous target loop share its native execution frame. Primary=launch+27, BlackMamba secondary=launch+78.
algorithm: Build all live native producer candidates across variants and both stages. A bounded event with one candidate intersects that launch with event bounds minus the stage offset. Repeat until no bound changes; never bootstrap from ambiguous events. Preserve original source inputs and ordered refinement witnesses.
admission: Exact actor, known effect family or verified secondary state family, command order, native bounds, normal finish for awaited primary only.
NPC contacts constrain time but do not become enemy hits.
Unbounded and conflicting clocks never narrow. Ambiguous producers and disjoint source-level orphans remain visible.
limits: No arbitrary time window or replay-tick conversion.
No claim of full metric completion from refinement alone.
